venue: Jim R. Miller Park & Event Center, Marietta
blurb:
Global food, live music, and performances from cultures all across Cobb County, and it doesn't cost you a thing to walk in.

The Cobb County International Festival lands at Jim R. Miller Park on Saturday from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM. It's a celebration of the diversity that's been quietly building in this county for years, brought out into the open with food vendors, visual arts, and performing artists representing heritages from around the world. Five hours of it, right in your backyard.

Bring the family or go solo. It's the kind of afternoon that's easy to show up to with no agenda, wander around for a couple of hours, eat something you've never tried before, and leave in a genuinely good mood. No tickets, no hassle, just show up.
scoring_notes: Free, family-friendly, and community-rooted. Fits East Cobb's mix of established families and empty nesters who are civically engaged. Saturday timing is ideal. Less unique than a one-night competition, but the cultural angle and zero cost make it broadly accessible and worth including.
